title: Meh!
text: Meh!. I like the shape. It fits the neck well. What I don't like is that it is really too firm to be very comfortable. It feels really blocky, squarish and not very soft. It is very uncomfortable on a long trip. I had to switch it out for another one I have on our trip to Yellowstone. It made my neck hurt. I have a very bad neck, so this may just be my issue, but there are so many other options available on Amazon that I can't really recommend this one.
